name: MEMSensing Microsystems (Suzhou, China) Co., Ltd.
summary: MEMSensing Microsystems (Suzhou, China) Co., Ltd. provides MEMS sensor products and solutions in China and internationally. The company provides MEMS acoustic sensors, MEMS pressure sensors, MEMS inertial sensors, MEMS force sensors, MEMS flow sensors, and infrared thermopile sensors for various industries, including consumer electronics, industrial control, medical electronics and automotive, etc. It also offers technical consultation and technical services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
